rv.q: 'The Band' is all about the redemptive power of fandom, but the black hole at the centre of this show is the actual band.

No, you don't have to be someone who goes wobbly at the opening bars of "Back For Good". But I'd only advise going along with a little respect for the work of Gary, Howard, Mark, Jason and Robbie. What's essential is a tolerance for '90s nostalgia.
